builderInsights.authorBio: ceo @box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
builderInsights.title: Aaron Levie
builderInsights.suggestedTitle: AI 定价正在快速分层
builderInsights.suggestedSummary: 他认为，AI 已经从便宜的 chatbot 走到了昂贵、需要高上下文的 agent。这个差距还会继续拉大。结果就是：前沿任务会继续为更好的 model 买单，而企业会搭建新系统，把工作路由给更便宜的 model，只要效果够用就行。

tweets.text:
What’s happened is that we went from AI chat tools that were relatively cheap and had small context windows, to AI agents that have giant context windows, the ability to keep track of longer running work, and models that cost an order of magnitude more on inference because they’re that much better.

This has compounded far faster than most realized (unless you were paying close attention at the middle or end of last year, which many here were), and the dollars flowing in now are much more real. 

What follows is a continued march of AI capability that will continue to be used by anyone with a frontier use-case (like coding, sciences, finance, consulting) and then a peeling off of tasks to lower cost models that are capable enough for the job. Whereas we thought the cost of AI might converge on a single low price per token before, it’s clear the stratification is only widening based on the task you need performed. 

This will be yet another component that has to be figured out for broad AI diffusion. Enterprises will need to put in programs, new finance teams, and technology solutions to manage this all. The labs and platforms that can ensure customers can price optimize for the task at hand will be in the best position.

podcastHighlights.suggestedTitle: AI 刚刚跨过可靠性门槛，真正的工作才刚开始
podcastHighlights.suggestedSummary:
**核心结论：** AI 进展之所以让人感觉像突然加速，不是因为能力一夜暴涨，而是模型终于足够可靠，开始真的能干活了。

- 最大的变化，是从刷 benchmark 转向处理真实世界里那些脏活累活："we moved from competitions to usefulness to users."
- Reinforcement learning 正在从数学和 coding 竞赛里走出来，开始覆盖实际知识工作、agentic coding 和科学任务。
- 效率和原始智能一样重要：目标是让模型少想一点、更快回退，并在更低 latency 下给出更好的答案。

blogUpdates.title: Claude Code auto mode：更安全地跳过 permissions 的方式
blogUpdates.suggestedTitle: Anthropic 为 Claude Code 加上 Auto Mode，让 autonomy 更安全
blogUpdates.suggestedSummary:
**Lead:** Anthropic 为 Claude Code 推出了 **Auto Mode**。这是一个新的 permission system。它不再要求人类每一步都点头，而是用 model-based classifiers 和 prompt-injection screening，让 agent 能更自主地跑，同时又不至于完全放飞。

**Numbers:**
- 手动 prompts 的接受率有 **93%**，这也在加重 approval fatigue。
- 评估覆盖了 **10,000** 次真实内部 tool calls、**52** 次真实 overeager actions，以及 **1,000** 次 synthetic exfiltration attempts。
- 完整 pipeline 的结果：在真实 traffic 上 **0.4% false-positive rate**，在真实 overeager actions 上 **17% false-negative rate**，在 synthetic exfiltration 上 **5.7% false-negative rate**。
- 只看 Stage 1：真实 overeager actions 上 **8.5% FPR**、**6.6% FNR**，synthetic exfiltration 上 **1.8% FNR**。

**So What:** Auto Mode 面向的是这类团队：想比 manual review 少打很多 permission prompts，但又不想直接用 `--dangerously-skip-permissions` 这种裸奔模式。它用了两道防线：一是 server-side 的 prompt-injection probe，先扫输入；二是对 tool calls 做 transcript classifier，拦住高风险动作，比如 destructive deletes、credential hunting、exfiltration，还有绕过 safety checks。Anthropic 说，这套系统从设计上就偏保守："**The classifier is deliberately conservative**"。它看的是动作在现实里的影响，不只是表面文本。实际建议很简单：先用保守默认值，再随着时间慢慢调 trusted environments 和 exceptions。日常 coding 很有用，但在高风险 infrastructure 上，还是不能替代认真做 human review。
